{

  "workflow_yaml": "# Workflow derived from https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2/examples
# Need help debugging build failures? Start at https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

name: pkgdown.yaml

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  pkgdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Only restrict concurrency for non-PR jobs
    concurrency:
      group: pkgdown-${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.run_id }}
    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2

      - name: Cache R package library
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.R_LIBS_USER }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-r-deps-${{ hashFiles('DESCRIPTION') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-r-deps-

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: any::pkgdown, local::.
          needs: website

      - name: Install Miniconda
        run: |
          reticulate::install_miniconda()
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Install TensorFlow
        run: |
          reticulate::conda_create('r-reticulate', packages = c('python==3.11'))
          tensorflow::install_tensorflow(version='2.16')
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Build site
        run: pkgdown::build_site_github_pages(new_process = FALSE, install = FALSE)
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub pages 🚀
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4.5.0
        with:
          clean: false
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: docs",
  "rationale": "The workflow re-fetches and installs R dependencies (via setup-r-dependencies) plus a Miniconda/TensorFlow environment on every run, which is repeated dependency fetching. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) supports adding a dependency cache before installation, keyed on the dependency manifest, while keeping installation and all required tests. Preconditions are met: dependency fetching happens every run and DESCRIPTION serves as the cache input; no contraindication applies (no equivalent cache exists, content is pinned). A cache step for the R package library is inserted after setup-r and before setup-r-dependencies, keyed on hashFiles('DESCRIPTION'), so a changed DESCRIPTION invalidates the cache and a full reinstall still occurs. All original steps, triggers, permissions, and the build/deploy coverage are preserved unchanged; no secrets, privileged actions, publishing changes, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
